port.label: Port
port.description: The port Subsonic apps connect to. In the app, enter http://<this server>:<port> as the server address.

bind_ip.label: Listen address
bind_ip.description: The network address to listen on. 0.0.0.0 listens on every network, including Tailscale. Never forward this port on your router.

music_folders.label: Music folders
music_folders.description: The local music folders Subsonic apps can see. Leave empty for all of them.

log_requests.label: Log every request
log_requests.description: Write each Subsonic call (without passwords) to the Music Assistant log. Useful while testing an app; errors are always logged.

server_type.label: Server type reported to apps
server_type.description: Some apps enable extra features for Navidrome. Those features may use Navidrome's own web API, which this server doesn't have.

subsonic_password.label: Subsonic password for {0} (login: {1})
subsonic_password.description: Leave empty to give this user no Subsonic access. Use a new password made just for Subsonic: apps send it with every request and some store it unencrypted.

manifest.description: Lets Subsonic apps (Arpeggi, Symfonium, play:Sub, ...) browse and play the music files in your library, like a Navidrome server.
